title: SPECIAL REGULATIONS WITHIN SUBDISTRICT A
previewText: The regulations of Section 136-30, inclusive, shall apply within Subdistrict A, as shown on Map 1 (Special Downtown Far Rockaway District and Subdistrict) in the Appendix to this Chapter. The regulations of the Special Downtown Far Rockaway District shall apply, except as modified by the regulations of Section 136-30, inclusive.
